card.name: Digits inside counts and file sizes
card.fires_on: Digits inside a number in brackets, such as a result count, a category count, or a file size after Download. It fires on the first or middle digit, before the number ends.

modes.label: Category counts
modes.description: Digits in the number in brackets after a category name in a website list.

modes.label: File sizes
modes.description: Leading digit of a file size after a Download link, before KB, Kb or MB.

modes.label: Result counts
modes.description: A number in brackets giving how many items or videos were found.

card.plain: It marks the digits in small bracketed numbers on web pages, like item counts and download sizes.
